newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks surge, Zagrebacka at a record high.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks surge, Zagrebacka at a record high.

text.p: Croatian stocks, led by Zagrebacka Banka, surged on Wednesday in buoyant trade and were seen as continuing to firm.
* Fifteen of 16 active issues rose and only one fell.
* Volume more than doubled to 26,572 units and turnover jumped to 23.9 million kuna from Tuesday's 6.7 million.
* Top gainer was Zagrebacka ordinary stock, closing 170 kuna or 9.19 percent higher at a record 2,020 kuna on volume of 7,717 units.
* Another blue chip Pliva added 3.33 percent to 465 kuna on volume of 5,988 shares.
* Food concern Podravka, with 9,051 shares sold, was the most activelly traded issue. It gained one kuna to 300.
* The only loser was hotelier Arenaturist, down 30 kuna to 150 from late in February on volume of 30 shares.
